role.altitude: The two HR Administrators stop re-keying data and answering the same mail. They spend their time on the answer content and the exceptions queue, and they decide unclear dossier and hiring cases. They own the answer content and the dossier-completeness checklist for all three sites, and they decide when an exception goes to an HRBP or Payroll.
reach: Payroll Specialist: month-close input checks, so new hires and contract changes land correctly in the payroll run
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: AFAS connectors and the Power BI extract, so the administrator can maintain completeness checks and dashboards
HR Business Partner: absence case files under Wet verbetering poortwachter, so the administrator can prepare paperwork without putting health data in model prompts
Learning and Development Specialist: Studytube mandatory certificates, so a missing forklift or VCA certificate is caught before a shift starts
skills_to_grow: Writing and structuring CAO and policy answer content, with a named owner per topic
Reading and adjusting AFAS workflows, UpdateConnectors and Pocket onboarding settings
Exception handling: deciding when a case leaves the standard route and who takes it
AVG/GDPR and EU AI Act basics for HR data: special-category data, Art. 22, Art. 50 transparency
Reading a Power BI completeness dashboard and turning gaps into actions
role.ambitious_version: Run one HR front door for all 1,200 employees and the 150 to 300 flex workers. Personal entitlements are quoted from AFAS, CAO and policy answers come from owned content, and every hire has a complete dossier on day one. The administrator reports weekly on questions resolved without a ticket, days per personnel action and dossier completeness per site.

tasks.short: Answer employee questions on leave, salary scales, benefits, eligibility and CAO rules by mail, Teams and phone.

steps.what: Receive and sort questions from mail, Teams, phone and walk-ins

loop.input: employee question text in Dutch, English or Polish
loop.output: topic label: personal entitlement, CAO/policy, or escalate
loop.check: label must be in the fixed topic list; health or complaint words route to escalate
loop.stop: one classification call; low confidence or no label goes to the HR queue
loop.why_not_simpler: questions arrive as free text in several languages; keyword rules miss too many

steps.what: Look up the employee's own data in AFAS: leave balance, scale, contract
Find the matching CAO article or policy on SharePoint

loop.input: question plus approved HR content pages tagged by owner
loop.output: top passages with page and article reference
loop.check: answer may only cite retrieved approved passages; no passage means no answer
loop.stop: one retrieval and one answer draft; no match goes to the HR queue
loop.why_not_simpler: employees phrase questions in their own words; a fixed FAQ menu covers too little of the CAO

steps.what: Write and send the answer to the employee

loop.input: policy passage and the AFAS figure
loop.output: short answer with the figure quoted verbatim and the source linked, marked as AI
loop.check: figures are inserted by code, not generated; tone rules in configuration; weekly sample reviewed by the administrator
loop.stop: one draft; if the check fails the question becomes a ticket
loop.why_not_simpler: policy answers need plain wording fitted to the question; templates alone cover only the top questions

steps.what: Handle escalated questions: disputes, exceptions, sensitive situations

tasks.design: Put a Teams bot in front of the HR mailbox. It quotes personal entitlements through a deterministic AFAS lookup and answers CAO and policy questions from SharePoint content with named owners, in a bounded retrieve-and-draft loop. Anything it cannot answer becomes a ticket in the existing HR queue with the employee profile attached, and a monthly report shows content gaps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Answers depend on contract type, site, CAO and tenure. Old chatbots could not combine personal data with free-text policy, so wrong answers about pay were a real risk.
tasks.enabler_now: Models can read free-text questions and cite approved content, and AFAS exposes personal data through GetConnectors. A comparable HR bot runs at scale on a daily HR data sync [S1].
tasks.still_hard: Keeping the CAO and policy content current, per site and per CAO, takes owner time every month. Shop-floor workers without a work account need another way in, such as WhatsApp or a kiosk.
tasks.human_edge: Disputes, hardship cases and questions where the honest answer is 'it depends on your manager' need a person who knows the sites and the people.

ambition.what: Flex workers from the three agencies get answers on site rules, shift allowances and certificates. Today they mostly ask their agency or their team lead.

tasks.altitude: The administrator stops typing answers and becomes the content owner for HR answers. They decide which topics the bot may answer and they handle the escalations.

reach.learn: How shift and overtime allowances are calculated, so payslip questions can be answered without a ticket
Where the CAO leaves room for judgement, so the bot routes those questions instead of answering

evidence.claim: An HR bot answering per region, contract and tenure from a daily SAP sync, with ticket escalation, is used by a third of 3,600 employees with CSAT 4.1
A chatbot beside the old workflow saves about 3% of hours; time comes from redesigning the workflow
Employee-facing bots must disclose they are AI since 2 August 2026
A bot answering from the personnel file needs works council consent under WOR art. 27(1)(k)
Content structure and a named owner per topic mattered more than the model; tone needed global configuration

assumptions: About 170 hours a year across both administrators go to this task
AFAS GetConnectors expose leave balance, scale and contract type
Most office staff use Teams; many warehouse staff have no work mailbox
unknowns: How many questions arrive per week, by channel and by site
Whether shop-floor and flex workers have Microsoft 365 accounts
Whether the policies and both CAOs are on SharePoint in current, structured form
The works council's position on logging questions per employee
research_questions: What share of last quarter's HR mailbox questions could be answered from AFAS data plus written policy alone?
Can AFAS GetConnectors return per-employee leave and contract data to a bot under a service account, with access limited to the asking employee?
Will the works council consent if question logs are pseudonymised and not used to assess employees?
Do warehouse staff use Teams on their phones, or is a WhatsApp or kiosk channel needed to reach them?

tasks.short: Process new-hire paperwork: collect data, enter employee and contract in AFAS, issue contract, notify others.

steps.what: Collect new-hire personal data, bank details, tax form, ID copy
Re-key offer and personal data into AFAS employee and contract
Draft the employment contract from the Word template per CAO
Send the contract for signature and chase it
Check the original ID document in person on day one
Notify payroll, IT, manager; enrol in Studytube mandatory courses

tasks.design: A hire in Recruitee triggers a scheduled integration that creates a draft employee and contract in AFAS for the administrator to approve. AFAS Pocket onboarding collects the new hire's own data and documents, with Jonas reading the documents into fields. After approval, AFAS generates the CAO contract from a template and sends it for signature, and the same job notifies payroll, IT and the manager and enrols the hire in Studytube by role.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recruitee and AFAS were never linked. Contract variants per CAO and site lived in Word templates, and nobody owned building the connector.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS Profit 8 has Pocket pre-boarding and Jonas document reading [S4]. Connector code between documented APIs is now cheap to write and test.
tasks.still_hard: Contract variants for two CAOs, three sites and fixed-term rules need careful templating. The employer must still check original ID documents in person.
tasks.human_edge: Approving the contract terms, handling unusual offers, and checking the ID face to face stay with the administrator.

ambition.what: Check every new hire's dossier for completeness before day one, not after the first payroll run.

tasks.altitude: The administrator approves drafts and handles exceptions instead of typing. They decide whether a dossier is ready for the payroll cut-off.

reach.learn: Which offer fields AFAS needs, so offers arrive complete and the integration does not stop

reach.task: Add new hires to the month-close payroll run
reach.learn: Payroll cut-off dates and loonheffing rules, so drafts are approved in time

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit 8 Jonas reads documents into dossier fields and Pocket lets new hires submit data before day one
SixFifty drafts contracts and sends them for signature within strict workflows on a maintained law base (US only)
Recruitee and AFAS both expose APIs for candidate and employee records

assumptions: Roughly 300 to 500 hires a year including warehouse staff, not counting agency flex workers
AFAS Profit is or can be upgraded to version 8
Contract templates are stable enough to move into AFAS
unknowns: Number of hires per year per site and per CAO
Whether the AFAS licence includes Pocket onboarding and Jonas
How many contract template variants exist
Which e-signature method is already used
research_questions: How many contract variants are really in use, and can they be built as AFAS templates with conditional clauses?
What is Jonas's field error rate on Dutch ID copies and loonheffing forms in a two-week test?
How often do Recruitee offers lack fields AFAS requires, and who should fix them?
Does a direct Recruitee-to-AFAS draft cut the days from offer accepted to complete dossier?

tasks.short: Search employee files in AFAS and old documents to answer requests and prepare personnel actions.

steps.what: Receive request from manager, HRBP, payroll or employee
Look up contract history, dates, scale and absence in AFAS
Read scanned contracts and letters in the digital dossier

loop.input: scanned contract or letter, excluding documents tagged medical
loop.output: dates, contract type, agreed terms, with page reference
loop.check: extracted dates checked against AFAS contract records; mismatches flagged
loop.stop: one extraction per document; unreadable or mismatched goes to the administrator
loop.why_not_simpler: older dossier documents are scans and letters without structured fields

steps.what: Compile the answer or statement, such as a werkgeversverklaring
Check chain rule and CAO limits before contract extension

tasks.design: Requests come in through an AFAS workflow form instead of mail. A deterministic job pulls contract history from AFAS, computes chain-rule and CAO checks, and fills standard statements from templates. A bounded extraction loop reads only non-medical scanned documents and flags mismatches. The administrator approves anything that leaves the company.
tasks.previous_blocker: Old dossiers are scans, and chain-rule checks lived in personal Excel sheets. Nobody coded the CAO exceptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Extraction from scanned documents is reliable enough with a check against structured AFAS dates. Rule code for the ketenregeling is quick to write and test.
tasks.still_hard: Special-category data (health, union membership) sits in the same dossiers and must be kept out of model prompts. CAO deviations on the chain rule need careful encoding.
tasks.human_edge: Deciding what a request is really for, and whether sharing a fact is allowed under AVG, stays with the administrator.

ambition.what: A monthly list of contracts nearing the chain-rule limit for every manager, 3 months before the deadline.

tasks.altitude: The administrator stops searching and starts signing off statements and flagging risks. They decide which facts may be shared and with whom.

reach.task: Decide contract extensions and permanent contracts
reach.learn: How managers weigh extension against the chain rule, so the monthly list shows what they need

reach.task: Maintain the Power BI HR extract
reach.learn: How contract fields are modelled, so the checks run on the nightly extract

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit 8 Jonas reads documents into dossier fields
Health data is special-category under GDPR Art. 9 and should stay out of model prompts
Chain rule: more than three fixed-term contracts or over three years leads to a permanent contract unless the CAO deviates

assumptions: Most requests concern contract history, dates and employer statements
Dossier documents in AFAS carry a type tag that can mark medical documents
unknowns: Share of dossiers that exist only as scans
Whether the warehouse CAO deviates from the chain rule
Volume of requests per month by type
research_questions: What share of last month's file requests could be answered from AFAS fields alone, without opening documents?
Are medical and other special-category documents tagged reliably enough to exclude them automatically?
Does the chain-rule check agree with the HRBP's manual list for all current fixed-term contracts?

tasks.short: Chase and collect missing personnel documents and certificates from employees, managers and staffing agencies.

steps.what: Find which dossiers miss documents or certificates
Chase employees, managers and agencies by mail and phone
Receive documents and file them in the AFAS dossier

loop.check: employee matched on number and name in AFAS; date must parse and be plausible
loop.stop: one pass; no match or low confidence goes to the exceptions queue
loop.why_not_simpler: documents arrive as photos and PDFs of many types and layouts

steps.what: Pull certificates from Studytube and agency portals into one list

tasks.design: Replace the Excel tracking sheet with a nightly job that compares AFAS dossiers, Studytube certificates and agency worker lists against a checklist per role and site. It sends reminders by Teams or mail and shows gaps in a Power BI dashboard. Uploads go through AFAS Pocket, a bounded classification loop files them, and the administrator handles only unmatched items and staff who must be approached in person.
tasks.previous_blocker: The data sat in three systems and three agency portals with no shared key. The checklist per role lived in someone's head and an Excel sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Connector and matching code is now cheap to build, and AFAS Pocket gives employees an upload channel [S4]. Document classification with a match check is good enough for filing.
tasks.still_hard: Agency portals may have no API, so exports or scraping are needed. Warehouse staff without email still need a face-to-face reminder from a team lead.
tasks.human_edge: Getting a reluctant employee or a busy shift lead to hand over a document is a people job.

ambition.what: Track forklift, VCA and food-safety certificates for agency flex workers, not only for own staff.

tasks.altitude: The administrator stops chasing and works from an exceptions list. They decide when a missing certificate is escalated to the site manager.

reach.task: Plan mandatory certificate renewals in Studytube
reach.learn: Renewal cycles per certificate, so reminders go out before expiry
Which agency worker list matches the invoice, so both use the same worker key

evidence.claim: AFAS Pocket lets employees submit data and Jonas reads documents into dossier fields
Studytube exposes course and certificate data by API
Re-keying and corrections are the main wastes in HR records work

assumptions: Each site has a known list of mandatory certificates per role
Agencies can deliver worker and certificate lists in a fixed format
unknowns: Whether the three agency portals offer an API or only exports
Current dossier completeness rate per site
Whether the works council sees certificate tracking as performance monitoring
research_questions: What is the dossier completeness rate today per site, and how much does it rise in the first month of automated reminders?
Can all three agencies deliver certificate data for their flex workers through an API or a weekly file?
Does the works council treat certificate and document tracking as monitoring under WOR art. 27(1)(l)?
